approvedCandidates.title: The Fall
approvedCandidates.rationale: The root of the redemption story; its absence is the single most conspicuous hole for any churchgoer. Kid version is a separate, harder story from Creation (1834).
approvedCandidates.verificationMethod: full_corpus_automated; re-confirmed targeted_opus_gate (0 meta hits both lanes)
approvedCandidates.cautions: VERY HEAVY. Kid version is a separate, harder story from Creation (1834); keep a 'God stays WITH' framing on the exile/consequence.
approvedCandidates.notes: Native lane note: Seeds a primeval origins arc (Creation → Fall → Cain → Flood)
